app_fee.value: International applicants pay USD 95 (USD 85 for domestic applicants).

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate School waives the fee only in exceptional circumstances; departments set their own rules and several do not waive it for international applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: Under exceptional circumstances, the Graduate School may waive the application fee.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School leaves GRE to each program; see the program records.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT total of at least 4 (new scale) for tests taken after Jan 21, 2026, with each section at least 4; older-scale tests need 80 with 18 per section. Programs may ask for more.
toefl_min.quote: Provide Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) (taken after January 21, 2026) with a total score of at least 4 on the Internet-based

also.quote: with a total score of at least 80 on the Internet-based Test (iBT)

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with each section at least 6.5 (speaking 6.5 for admission, 7.0 for a TA post).
ielts_min.quote: Provide Academic International English Language Testing System (IELTS) scores with an overall band score of at least 6.5.

english_waiver.value: The waiver is based on citizenship of an English-official country (plus a year of US study), not on an Indian English-medium degree; India is not named, so assume a test is needed.

notes: grad.ncsu.edu returned 502 for every page; Graduate School rules taken from the official Graduate Handbook and catalog. The program list is the catalog Programs A-Z.
